title: Pro AWD
exclusionReason: No side-view camera available (standard or optional)
infotainment: ID. Cockpit with 12.9-inch touchscreen, 5.3-inch driver display, ID. Software 4.x with IDA voice assistant
adasStandard: IQ.DRIVE standard: Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop & Go, Travel Assist, Lane Assist, Front Assist (AEB with pedestrian/cyclist detection), Side Assist (BSM), Rear Traffic Alert, Emergency Assist, Dynamic Road Sign Display, Park Assist Plus, high beam control. Source: https://www.vwofkirkland.com/blog/2025/april/26/blog-top-10-safety-features-of-the-vw-id-4.htm
adasOptional: No additional ADAS upgrades at the Pro AWD trim.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines and Rear Traffic Alert. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/volkswagen/id4/2025/
sideViewCameraNotes: No surround-view 360 at Pro AWD; Side Assist is radar-based. Surround-view available starting at Pro S Plus. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/volkswagen/id4/2025/
subscriptionFeatures: myVW+ / Car-Net Connected Services (Remote Start/Climate/Lock, Vehicle Health, Geofencing, Speed Alert, Stolen Vehicle Locator, Wi-Fi Hotspot) with trial then $15-25/mo. Source: https://carnet.vw.com/
drmNotes: Same as Pro RWD — always-on cellular modem, subscription-gated remote features, core driving works offline. Sources: https://www.vwidtalk.com/threads/disable-all-connected-services.15608/
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving-detection kill switch documented. Emergency Assist exists as part of IQ.DRIVE but is a driver-incapacitation rescue, not the IIJA-mandated impairment detector.
knownIssues: Same family as Pro RWD: touchscreen freezes / phantom warnings improved by ID. Software 3.0+. AWD-specific: earlier MY (2021-2023) had a rear-motor pulse-inverter failure pattern; MY2025 builds use the revised inverter. Source: https://www.vwidtalk.com/
recalls: Check NHTSA by VIN. MY2025 has had fewer new recalls than the earlier MY family. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle/2025/VOLKSWAGEN/ID.4/SUV/AWD
stateIncentives: Varies by state. See state DMV / EV incentive portal at time of purchase. Source: https://recharged.com/articles/2025-vw-id4

title: Pro RWD
exclusionReason: No side-view camera available (standard or optional)
infotainment: ID. Cockpit with 12.9-inch central touchscreen running ID. Software (latest 4.x family at MY2025), 5.3-inch driver display, embedded ChatGPT-enabled voice assistant via IDA on later MY2025 production
adasStandard: IQ.DRIVE is standard across all 2025 ID.4 trims and includes: Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop & Go, Travel Assist (hands-on lane-centering up to highway speeds), Lane Assist (lane departure warning + lane-keeping), Front Assist (automatic emergency braking with pedestrian / cyclist detection), Side Assist (blind spot monitor), Rear Traffic Alert, Emergency Assist (slows the car if it detects driver incapacitation), Dynamic Road Sign Display, Park Assist Plus, and high beam control. Source: https://www.vwofkirkland.com/blog/2025/april/26/blog-top-10-safety-features-of-the-vw-id-4.htm
adasOptional: No additional ADAS upgrades over IQ.DRIVE at the Pro trim level — higher trims add the surround-view camera and memory-park features.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view backup camera with dynamic guidelines and the Rear Traffic Alert overlay. Resolution is not published by VW but is described in owner reviews as adequate, not class-leading. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/volkswagen/id4/2025/st-402026157/features-specs/
sideViewCameraNotes: No surround-view 360 camera and no Honda-LaneWatch-style side camera at the Pro trim. Blind-spot detection is radar-only (Side Assist). Surround-view is available starting at Pro S Plus. Source: https://www.edmunds.com/volkswagen/id4/2025/st-402026157/features-specs/
subscriptionFeatures: myVW+ / Car-Net Connected Services: includes a complimentary trial (typically 1-3 years depending on package) covering Remote Start, Remote Climate, Remote Door Lock/Unlock, Vehicle Health, Geofencing, Speed Alert, Stolen Vehicle Locator, Last Mile Navigation, Send-to-Car, and Hotspot data. After the trial expires, plans run roughly $15-25/month or $150-200/year depending on tier. The 12.9-inch infotainment supports premium navigation, premium speech recognition (cloud-based), and premium radio as add-on tiers. SiriusXM trial included. Sources: https://carnet.vw.com/ ; https://www.vw.com/en/owners-and-services/connectivity-and-apps/connected-services.html
drmNotes: The ID.4 has an always-on cellular modem that transmits telemetry even with myVW+ unsubscribed. Core driving functions (motor, steering, braking, IQ.DRIVE, infotainment local features, CarPlay/Android Auto) work fully offline. Subscription-gated features (remote start, remote climate, geofencing, vehicle health alerts, Wi-Fi hotspot, premium nav, premium speech, premium radio) lapse when myVW+ / Car-Net trial expires. OTA updates roll out via ID. Software releases; owners have reported software glitches before and after updates. Sources: https://www.vwidtalk.com/threads/disable-all-connected-services.15608/ ; https://carnet.vw.com/
killSwitchNotes: No impaired-driving-detection kill switch is documented for the 2025 ID.4. IQ.DRIVE includes an Emergency Assist that decelerates and stops the car if it believes the driver is unresponsive (no steering input after audible/visual warnings), but this is a driver-attention rescue feature, not the IIJA-mandated impairment detector. Sources: https://www.vwofkirkland.com/blog/2025/april/26/blog-top-10-safety-features-of-the-vw-id-4.htm
knownIssues: Reported in owner forums and Consumer Reports: 12-inch touchscreen freezes / black-screens (improved by ID. Software 3.0+), phantom warning chimes, door-handle electronics (subject of an earlier recall for MY2021-2023, ID.4 specifically), occasional 12-V battery drain in long-park scenarios, intermittent Car-Net subscription failures, and AWD rear-motor pulse-inverter failures from earlier MY (subject of TSB). Sources: https://www.vwidtalk.com/ ; https://insideevs.com/news/533041/volkswagen-id4-awd-epa-range/
recalls: Pre-MY2025 recalls included rear-motor pulse inverter (MY2021-2023 AWD), door-handle electrical issue, charging-related software, and seat-belt sensor. As of 2025-2026 the MY2025 ID.4 has had relatively few new recalls, partly because much of the prior software bundle was corrected before launch and applied via OTA. Check NHTSA recall lookup by VIN. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle/2025/VOLKSWAGEN/ID.4/SUV/AWD
stateIncentives: Eligibility varies. Major examples (varied by year): CA Clean Vehicle Rebate Project (closed late 2023, replaced by income-restricted CARB programs), CO innovative motor vehicle credit ($5,000), NY Drive Clean Rebate ($500-2,000), NJ Charge Up ($2,000-4,000), MA MOR-EV ($3,500), CT CHEAPR ($2,250-4,250 income-dependent), and various utility-rebate programs. Confirm with the state DMV / state EV incentive portal at purchase time. Source: https://recharged.com/articles/2025-vw-id4

title: Pro S
infotainment: ID. Cockpit with 12.9-inch central touchscreen, 5.3-inch driver display, ID. Software 4.x with IDA voice assistant. Wireless App-Connect (CarPlay/Android Auto), wireless phone charging, 8-speaker audio. 3 climate zones standard.
adasStandard: IQ.DRIVE is standard on every ID. Buzz: Adaptive Cruise Control with Stop & Go, Travel Assist (lane-centering), Lane Assist, Front Assist (AEB with pedestrian/cyclist detection), Side Assist (BSM), Rear Traffic Alert, Emergency Assist, Dynamic Road Sign Display, Park Assist Plus, Park Distance Control front + rear, high beam control, 360-degree Area View camera. IIHS noted the AEB system is weaker than peers in some scenarios. Sources: https://media.vw.com/releases/1894 ; https://www.iihs.org/ratings/vehicle/volkswagen/id.buzz-minivan/2025
adasOptional: All ADAS standard on Pro S; higher trims add convenience features (memory seats, hands-free liftgate) rather than additional ADAS hardware.
rearViewCameraNotes: Standard rear-view camera with dynamic guidelines + Rear Traffic Alert; image feeds into the standard surround-view (Area View) composite. Source: https://www.vw.com/idhub/content/dam/onehub_pkw/importers/us/en/showrooms/id-buzz/2025/tech-specs/ID_Buzz_Pro_S_Technical_Data.pdf
sideViewCameraNotes: Standard 360-degree surround-view (Area View) on every US ID. Buzz trim including base Pro S, with multiple selectable angles. No Honda-LaneWatch single-angle side camera; blind-spot via radar.
subscriptionFeatures: myVW+ / Car-Net Connected Services with trial then $15-25/mo. 2-year Electrify America Pass+ membership included.
drmNotes: Same connectivity model as the ID.4: always-on cellular modem, subscription-gated remote features via myVW+ / Car-Net, core driving offline. OTA updates via ID. Software.
killSwitchNotes: No IIJA impairment-detection kill switch documented. Emergency Assist (incapacitated-driver rescue) is part of IQ.DRIVE.
knownIssues: First model year in the US; reported issues include occasional ID. Software glitches inherited from the ID family (touchscreen freezes, phantom warnings), heavy curb weight reducing real-world range below EPA in highway driving, IIHS-flagged headlights and AEB performance. Sources: https://recharged.com/articles/vw-id-buzz-safety-rating-crash-test ; https://www.iihs.org/ratings/vehicle/volkswagen/id.buzz-minivan/2025
recalls: Limited recall history given the model is new for MY2025. Check NHTSA by VIN. Source: https://www.nhtsa.gov/vehicle/2025/VOLKSWAGEN/ID.%20BUZZ
stateIncentives: ID. Buzz is built in Hannover, Germany — does NOT qualify for the IRA $7,500 federal purchase credit on the basis of final assembly location. State credits vary; some states (CT CHEAPR, CO IMVC, MA MOR-EV, NY Drive Clean) may still apply at reduced amounts. Lease pass-through of the commercial-vehicle credit was historically used by some dealers but is unreliable. Source: https://www.cars.com/articles/volkswagen-id-buzz-skips-u-s-market-for-2026-519884/
